summary: Tested 4 features on backend and frontend: the copy-login button, the welcome email, Support Worker first-week onboarding and the Teams announcements channel. Backend: all 16 new pytest checks pass. They cover: a new Support Worker gets a temporary password, logs in, changes password, then is_new_starter is true and checklist ticks work. Office users and workers with an old start date are not new starters and get 403. The in-app 'Welcome to No Limitts!' notification is created. The send_welcome HTML passes the real email safety checks when send_email is mocked, for both office and Support Worker emails, and @example.com is skipped. Teams announcements endpoints: 403 for non-admins, 400 for bad URLs, 400 for a toggle-only PUT when not linked, link (webhook stored encrypted), toggles persist, DELETE works. announce() is called on update and event creation for non-hidden users only, and it respects the toggles and never raises. Frontend: all requested flows pass. The copy button switches to 'Copied!' and the clipboard text is correct. The Announcements channel box handles invalid-URL toast, link, toggle and unlink. A new-starter worker sees the Home card and the Library row; admins see neither. The login screen renders. One UI text bug: the first-week checklist hero still says 'Welcome to Aspire & Grow'. No deprecated Expo packages found.

minor.endpoint: data: forms 'Worker Screening & Set Up' (form_7528aa4b52ec, category New Starter)
minor.issue: Audience is ['support_office'] only, so Support Workers (the only new starters now) never see it in their checklist. POST /starter-checklist/form:form_7528aa4b52ec returns 404 'Form not found' for a worker. Check this is intended.
Uses date.today() (server UTC) instead of DIGEST_TZ (Australia). The 30-day boundary can be off by one day. Low impact.
5 old tests now fail only because Microsoft is configured: they assert the 'not configured' status and redirects. These tests are out of date; this is not a product bug.

ui_bugs.issue: Shows 'Welcome to Aspire & Grow' (old brand). Should be 'Welcome to No Limitts'. Reference: /app/frontend/app/starter-checklist.tsx:56

action_items: Change the starter-checklist hero text at /app/frontend/app/starter-checklist.tsx:56 from 'Welcome to Aspire & Grow' to 'Welcome to No Limitts'. Optionally also clean up the old 'Aspire & Grow' strings in socials.py author_name, the cpd.py and profile.py PDF footers, and events.py ICS PRODID.
Decide whether the 'Worker Screening & Set Up' New Starter form should include the support_worker audience. It is currently office-only.
Optional: in team.tsx copyLogin, wrap Clipboard.setStringAsync in try/catch so a clipboard failure shows an error toast instead of an unhandled rejection.
critical_code_review_comments: The Support Worker welcome email puts the temporary password in plain text. This is what was requested, and must_change_password is forced on first login, so the risk is acceptable. Note that reset-password does not re-send an email; the admin copies the details manually.
announce() decrypts the webhook and sends with retries in a background spawn, and errors are logged. This is good.
